for_you.ask: Is the other conductor helper yours?
for_you.detail: At 15:57 and 16:03 a conductor helper wrote your card and opened WS-171 (your two infographics). It is not me: it is a different session. Having two helpers with the same name can make them overwrite each other. This morning you chose me, so I have left its work alone.

for_you.ask: Tell Dinis that 'riskmandate-indi' is your GitHub name
for_you.detail: Dinis's security helper cannot yet lock secrets to your helpers' keys, because your GitHub name is not on the team list as yours (WS-170, WS-152). Dinis confirmed Vicky's and Jose's. You only need to say yes, in your own words, to Dinis. If the name is wrong, tell me the right one.
for_you.recommend: Say yes to Dinis today, so your helpers can receive the team's private files.

for_you.ask: Plan the demo for no wifi
for_you.detail: The venue's rules ban phone hotspots (see the summit page). Your demo's backup was a hotspot. Your mentor suggests keeping a copy of the demo on the laptop, so it works with no network. A recording would also do.
options: my helpers make an offline copy
for_you.recommend: Ask your helpers for an offline copy: it is small, and the demo is only days away (WS-109).
